content.text: The great late Chuck Norris told Conan O’Brien how he got to fight Bruce Lee in film. 🍿Share this post with your friends and follow @ScreenThrill for all you need to know about movies 😃🎬 ( @teamcoco )now they can do a legendary fight in heaven 😭Chuck Norris actually died 25 years ago but Death has only just found the courage to tell him. R.I.P Legend.Truly Chuck is a Great American. Thanks for sharing your life with us.🙏🏼i hear that when chuck norris did push ups, he would push the ground down.RIP, LEGEND.Chuck Norris didnt die. He just lost 1 of his 9 lives.When Chuck Norris entered Heaven, the angels didn't sing. They just stood in a line and did 1,000 push-ups and then Chuck corrected their form.Those two did so much for martial arts.When Alexander Bell invented the telephone, he already had two missed calls from Chuck NorrisChuck is such a legend, amazing manIt still holds up because it's literally a duel between two humans moviing at human speeds doing moves you actually do to block and counter human movements!!
